import { defineTable, col } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "run_at" is timestamp without time zone, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
//   - "locked_at" is timestamp without time zone, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
//   - "failed_at" is timestamp without time zone, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
//   - "locked_by" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "queue" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "created_at" is timestamp without time zone, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
//   - "updated_at" is timestamp without time zone, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
export const delayedJobs = defineTable("delayed_jobs", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial().primaryKey(),
        priority: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        attempts: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        handler: col.text().notNull(),
        lastError: col.text(),
        runAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone"),
        lockedAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone"),
        failedAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone"),
        lockedBy: col.text(),
        queue: col.text(),
        createdAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone"),
        updatedAt: col.custom("timestamp without time zone")
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
